import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print('Sheets:', xls.sheet_names)
for s in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=s, header=None)
    print(f'--- Sheet: {s} shape={df.shape} ---')
    print(df.head(15).to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
print('Sheets:', wb.sheetnames)
for s in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[s]
    print(f'--- Sheet: {s} dims={ws.dimensions} max_row={ws.max_row} max_col={ws.max_column} ---')
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=min(ws.max_row, 20), values_only=True):
        print(row)

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

path = 'budget.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print('Archive members:')
    for n in names:
        print(' ', n)

    ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

    # Shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared.append(text)

    # Workbook sheets
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    sheets = [(sh.get('name'), sh.get('sheetId'), sh.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
              for sh in wb_root.findall('m:sheets/m:sheet', ns)]
    print('\nSheets:', sheets)

    # Map rId -> target
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rel_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels_root}

    for name, sid, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map.get(rid, '')
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        if target not in names:
            print(f'!! missing {target} for sheet {name}')
            continue
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        print(f'\n--- Sheet: {name} ({target}) ---')
        for row in root.findall('m:sheetData/m:row', ns):
            r = int(row.get('r'))
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                isel = c.find('m:is', ns)
                val = None
                if v is not None and v.text is not None:
                    if t == 's':
                        val = shared[int(v.text)]
                    else:
                        val = v.text
                elif isel is not None:
                    val = ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in isel.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                cells.append((ref, t, val))
            print(r, cells)
